title_metadata.theme: Design and Implementation of a Resource Assignment and Allocation Platform for Djezzy — Case Study: IT and HR Departments

abstract_fr: Ce travail porte sur la conception et la réalisation d'une plateforme web d'affectation et d'allocation des ressources pour Djezzy. L'objectif principal est de centraliser la gestion des profils employés, des compétences, des disponibilités et des charges de travail, tout en fournissant un workflow d'affectation complet avec traçabilité (audit trail). La solution utilise Laravel 13, Filament 5 et React/Inertia avec Tailwind CSS, et intègre une authentification renforcée (double facteur, clés d'accès).
abstract_fr_keywords: Allocation des ressources, Laravel, Filament, React, Inertia, Spatie Permission, Audit trail
abstract_en: This project involves the design and implementation of a web-based resource assignment and allocation platform for Djezzy. The main objective is to centralize employee profile management, skills tracking, availability monitoring, and workload distribution, while providing a complete assignment workflow with full audit traceability. The solution is built with Laravel 13, Filament 5, and React/Inertia with Tailwind CSS, and integrates strong authentication mechanisms (two-factor authentication, passkeys) via Laravel Fortify.
abstract_en_keywords: Resource Allocation, Laravel, Filament, React, Inertia, Spatie Permission, Audit Trail

chapter1.title: Generalities on the Web and Web Technologies

sections.title: Presentation of the Web
sections.content: The web is a system of interlinked hypertextual documents accessed via the Internet using protocols such as HTTP and HTTPS. It evolved from static HTML pages (Web 1.0) to interactive platforms (Web 2.0) and semantic web technologies (Web 3.0). Modern web applications rely on client-server architectures, RESTful APIs, and single-page application (SPA) frameworks to deliver rich user experiences without page reloads.

sections.title: Frontend Technologies
sections.content: Modern frontend development relies on component-based JavaScript frameworks. React (by Meta) is the most widely adopted, enabling declarative UI composition through reusable components. TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript for better maintainability. Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that enables rapid UI development without writing custom CSS. Inertia.js acts as a bridge between server-side routing (Laravel) and client-side rendering (React), eliminating the need for a separate API layer while preserving SPA behavior. Vite is a modern build tool that provides fast development server startup and optimized production builds via Rollup.

sections.title: Backend Technologies
sections.content: Laravel is a PHP MVC framework providing Eloquent ORM, migrations, middleware, Blade templating, and a rich ecosystem (Fortify for authentication, Spatie Permission for authorization). Filament is an admin panel builder for Laravel that provides CRUD resources, widgets, charts, and role-based access control out of the box. PostgreSQL is the recommended relational database for production, offering ACID compliance, JSON support, and partial unique indexes.

sections.title: Authentication and Authorization
sections.content: Laravel Fortify provides authentication scaffolding including registration, login, password reset, email verification, and two-factor authentication (2FA). Passkeys (WebAuthn) offer passwordless authentication using public-key cryptography. Spatie Laravel Permission implements role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions assigned to roles (super-admin, admin, hr, resource-manager, project-manager, employee).

chapter2.title: Preliminary Study
chapter2.organization_presentation: Djezzy (Orascom Telecom Algeria) is one of Algeria's leading telecommunications operators, providing mobile, internet, and enterprise services to millions of subscribers. The IT and HR departments jointly manage employee assignments across projects, requiring coordination between organizational structure (business units, departments, teams), employee profiles (skills, certifications, languages, availability), and project requirements. Resource allocation is currently performed manually using spreadsheets and email communication.
chapter2.problem_statement: How to centralize and streamline the resource assignment process across IT and non-IT projects? How to track employee workload and availability in real time? How to maintain a complete audit trail of assignment decisions? How to enforce a single active assignment per project while supporting multiple assignment modes (single employee, multiple employees, team, department)?
objectives: Centralize organizational structure management (business units, departments, teams, positions, locations)
Build comprehensive employee profiles with skills, certifications, languages, availability status, and workload tracking
Implement a project requirement system with typed requirements (skill, certification, language, experience, position, department, location, availability)
Design an assignment workflow with status machine (Pending → Approved → Active → Completed) plus Rejected and Cancelled states
Enforce single-active-assignment-per-project rule via database-level partial unique index
Provide full audit trail with Actor, Action, Timestamp, Old/New values, IP and User-Agent tracking
Build an admin dashboard with statistical widgets, workload charts, and alert tables
Implement role-based access control with 6 roles and 50+ granular permissions
Secure authentication with 2FA and passkey support via Laravel Fortify
chapter2.existing_system_analysis: Current resource allocation relies on Excel spreadsheets shared via email between HR managers and project managers. Employee skills and certifications are tracked informally. Workload is estimated verbally during weekly meetings. Assignment history is not recorded. There is no mechanism to detect when an employee is over-allocated across multiple projects simultaneously.
existing_system_critique: No centralized employee profile with verifiable skills and certifications
Workload estimation is subjective with no quantitative tracking
No audit trail for assignment decisions or status changes
Risk of over-allocation goes undetected until performance degrades
No enforcement of single-active-assignment rule — multiple managers can claim the same employee
Assignment history is lost when spreadsheets are overwritten or deleted

use_cases.name: Authentication with 2FA and Passkeys
use_cases.description: User logs in with email/password. If 2FA is enabled, a TOTP code or recovery code is required. Passkeys offer passwordless login via WebAuthn.
use_cases.preconditions: User has valid account. 2FA may be enabled. Passkey may be registered.
use_cases.postconditions: User is authenticated and redirected to dashboard or admin panel based on role.
main_flow: User navigates to login page and enters email and password
System validates credentials via Laravel Fortify
If 2FA is enabled, system displays TOTP challenge
User enters 6-digit code or recovery code
System verifies code and creates authenticated session
use_cases.alternative_flow: Passkey login: system triggers WebAuthn challenge, user verifies via biometric/security key, session is created without password.

use_cases.name: Manage Organization Structure
use_cases.description: Admin creates and manages business units, departments, teams, positions, and locations with hierarchical relationships (departments belong to business units, teams belong to departments, positions belong to teams).
use_cases.postconditions: Organization structure is updated with new or modified entities.
main_flow: Admin navigates to organization section in Filament panel
Admin selects entity type (business unit, department, team, position, or location)
System displays list view with search, filters, and sort
Admin creates or edits entity with form validation
System saves changes with audit log entry
use_cases.alternative_flow: Invalid parent reference triggers validation error. Deleting a parent with children triggers restrictOnDelete constraint.

use_cases.name: Create and Manage Employees
use_cases.description: HR creates employee profiles linked to organizational entities, then enriches with skills, certifications, languages, availability status, and workload data.
use_cases.preconditions: User authenticated with employee management permissions. Organizational structure exists.
use_cases.postconditions: Employee profile is created with complete profile data.
main_flow: HR navigates to employee management in Filament panel
HR creates new employee with personal info, department, position, location, employment type and status
HR adds skills with proficiency levels (beginner/intermediate/advanced/native)
HR adds certifications with verification status (pending/verified/rejected/expired)
HR adds languages with proficiency levels
HR sets availability status (available/partially available/unavailable/on leave) and workload percentages
use_cases.alternative_flow: Editing employee linked to active assignment triggers warning. Soft-deleting employee preserves assignment history.

use_cases.name: Create Project with Requirements
use_cases.description: Project manager creates a project, defines category, assignment mode, priority, dates, confidentiality level, and adds typed requirements (skills, certifications, languages, experience, position, department, location, availability).
use_cases.preconditions: User authenticated with project management permissions. Project categories exist.
use_cases.postconditions: Project is created in Draft status with defined requirements.
main_flow: PM navigates to project management in Filament panel
PM creates new project with name, description, category, assignment mode, priority, status, dates, and confidentiality level
System saves project in Draft status
PM adds project requirements (skill, certification, language, or other requirement types) with minimum level and weight
System validates and stores requirements
use_cases.alternative_flow: Changing assignment mode after assignment exists triggers validation. Status transitions follow: Draft → Submitted → Under Review → Staffing → Assigned → In Progress → Completed.

use_cases.name: Create Assignment with Status Workflow
use_cases.description: Resource manager creates an assignment linking employees or teams to a project, then progresses through status machine: Pending → Approved → Active → Completed (or Rejected/Cancelled at various stages).
use_cases.preconditions: User authenticated with assignment permissions. Project exists. Employees are active.
use_cases.postconditions: Assignment is created and status history is recorded. Single-active-per-project rule is enforced.
main_flow: RM navigates to assignment management in Filament panel
RM creates new assignment for a project with assignment type (employee/team/department)
System validates no current approved or active assignment exists for the project (partial unique index)
RM assigns members (employees) with allocation percentage, responsibility, and dates
RM assigns teams if applicable
Assignment starts in Pending status
Approver transitions assignment to Approved (records approver and timestamp)
RM activates the assignment (transitions to Active)
Upon completion, RM marks assignment Completed (triggers left_at date on all members)
use_cases.alternative_flow: Transition from Pending to Rejected or Cancelled records reason in status history. Cancellation allowed from Pending, Approved, or Active status only. DomainException thrown for invalid transitions.

use_cases.name: View Dashboard Analytics
use_cases.description: Dashboard displays key metrics: total employees by department, workload vs availability chart, projects by status, projects needing staffing, over-allocated employees, expiring certifications, and recent activity log.
use_cases.postconditions: Dashboard displays current state of organization and assignments.
main_flow: User navigates to dashboard (Filament panel for admin users, public dashboard for regular users)
System loads StatsOverview widget (total counts)
System loads EmployeesByDepartmentChart (bar chart)
System loads AllocationVsAvailabilityChart (grouped bar: workload vs availability per department)
System loads ProjectsByStatusChart (doughnut chart)
System loads alert tables: ProjectsNeedingStaffing, OverAllocatedEmployees, ExpiringCertifications
System loads RecentActivityTable (audit log entries)
use_cases.alternative_flow: Empty data states show placeholder messages. Charts are rendered client-side via Filament ChartWidget.

use_cases.name: Audit Trail
use_cases.description: Every assignment action (created, approved, activated, completed, rejected, cancelled) is recorded in audit_logs with actor ID, action, auditable type and ID, old/new values, IP address, and user agent.
use_cases.postconditions: Audit log entry is created for every state transition.
main_flow: Assignment state transition occurs (e.g., approve)
AssignmentService calls AuditService.assignmentTransition()
AuditService creates AuditLog record with action, old_values, new_values, IP, user_agent
Record is persisted to audit_logs table
use_cases.alternative_flow: Manual log entries can be created via AuditService.log() for any model and action.

chapter3.deployment: Laravel 13 monolith deployed on Apache/Nginx with PHP-FPM. Filament 5 admin panel at /admin path. React/Inertia frontend for public dashboard and settings pages. PostgreSQL recommended for production (SQLite for local development). Vite 8 for asset compilation. Authentication via Fortify with optional 2FA and passkeys.

conclusion.summary: This project successfully delivered a centralized resource assignment and allocation platform for Djezzy, replacing manual spreadsheet-based workflows with a secure, auditable, and role-based web application. The system manages 37 database tables covering organizational structure, employee profiles with skills/certifications/languages, project requirements, and a complete assignment lifecycle with status machine (Pending → Approved → Active → Completed) and database-enforced single-active-assignment-per-project rule. Full audit trail and workload analytics provide transparency and accountability.
conclusion.limitations: The automated recommendation engine is intentionally postponed to a future phase. Real-time notifications for assignment status changes are not yet implemented. The platform currently has no mobile-responsive interface for field access. Dashboard analytics are limited to aggregate views without drill-down capabilities.
perspectives: Implement AI-powered recommendation engine for automated skill-based resource matching
Add real-time notifications via WebSocket/Laravel Echo for assignment status changes
Develop a responsive mobile interface or dedicated mobile app for field access
Integrate with HR information systems (HRIS) for automatic employee data synchronization
Add workload forecasting and capacity planning projections
Implement multi-language support (Arabic/French) for the admin panel
